newsitem.title: USA: Elder-Beerman total sales off, same-stores up.
newsitem.headline: Elder-Beerman total sales off, same-stores up.

text.p: Elder-Beerman Stores Corp said Thursday that on a consolidated basis, comparable store sales for the four-week period ended August 2, 1997, fell 0.6 percent to $34.0 million, while same-store sales increased 1.0 percent.
Department store division sales fell 0.4 percent for the month, compared to the same period last year. On a comparable basis, sales rose 1.0 percent to $31.7 million.
Elder-Beerman also reported that sales from its Bee-Gee shoe division were 1.7 percent higher than the prior year on a comparable store basis.
However, total Bee-Gee store sales were 3.0 percent lower, due principally to the reduction of eight locations from the prior year.
Elder-Beerman operates 50 department stores in Ohio, Indiana, Illinois, Michigan, Wisconsin, Kentucky and West Virginia.
The Bee-Gee division operates 68 El-Bee and Shoebilee! shoe stores in seven states.
Elder-Beerman also operates two furniture superstores.
